method: Every managed asset was captured from the live jobs.chronicle.com site on 2026-09-22: employer logos via the job-board getasset endpoint (as rendered on listing/detail cards) or the jobseekers-frontend image proxy (as rendered on employer hub pages), employer hub heroes via the site's imagexr responsive image service, career-article thumbnails from The Chronicle's brightspot CDN, and the homepage hero background + brand icons from the site's own assets host. Files were hashed locally; asset_inventory.json is the machine-checked contract.
